card.fact_statement: The CNE reported that several people were arrested during the run-off vote for electoral anomalies.
card.source_span: The CNE said that several people, including poll workers, were arrested during the run-off vote on 13 April for electoral anomalies

target_qa_variants.question: หน่วยงานกำกับดูแลใดรายงานว่ามีผู้ถูกจับกุมหลายคนเนื่องจากความผิดปกติในการเลือกตั้ง ในระหว่างการลงคะแนนเสียงรอบตัดสินของการเลือกตั้งทั่วไปในเอกวาดอร์ปี 2025?
target_qa_variants.source_span: The CNE said that several people, including poll workers, were arrested during the run-off vote on 13 April for electoral anomalies
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Kept CNE as it is the standard acronym used internationally for the National Electoral Council of Ecuador.

backtranslation_en.question: Which regulatory agency reported that several people were arrested due to election irregularities during the runoff voting of the 2025 general election in Ecuador?

backtranslation_consistency.reason: The target language QA accurately translates the source question and expected answer without adding or losing information.
